penguins.title: The Two Too Powerful Penguins
penguins.tagline: Complete the Meow Pow Wow. Defeat the Dark Crystal.
pitch: Farm with a talking Star Crystal in your yard.
Turn monsters back with love: the Meow Pow Wow, more than the sword.
Befriend Cat-topia, merkitties and crystal babies. They leave you gifts overnight.

gangsters.title: Gangster's Paradise
gangsters.tagline: Hide. Farm. Build a gang. Take back your life.
gangsters.feel: Moody, told at night, with a wink.
pitch: Lie low on a farm under a name that isn't yours.
Recruit a crew, open fronts, print bills and keep the heat down.
Take the districts back from the President's thugs.
